scenes.title: 3:00 AM Dark Bedroom Spiral Interrupted by Paper Notepad Circuit-Breaker
scenes.era: 2022 Mind After Midnight clinical sleep-psychology protocol in an adult bedroom

layout.description: Moonlit master bedroom with an upholstered headboard, walnut nightstand holding a mechanical flip-style 3:00 AM clock, a leather-bound pocket notepad with brass pen, and a face-down phone.

positions.who: 50-year-old adult sleeper (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in navy cotton pajama shirt sitting bolt upright against pillows)
positions.where: seated upright in bed at 3:00 AM reaching first toward a glowing nightstand object before pivoting to jot three strokes on a paper notepad
positions.facing: three-quarter view toward the walnut nightstand

positions.who: Sleeping spouse / quiet bedroom companion (stylized 2.5D vinyl character resting peacefully beside on the right)
positions.where: asleep under the linen duvet providing calm visual contrast to the wide-awake 3:00 AM spiral

props.name: Cream pocket paper notepad and weighted brass pen on walnut nightstand
props.period_detail: tactile unlined pocket notebook and heavy brass ballpoint pen with zero readable text
props.physical_behavior: State A clenched restless hands grip the duvet edge in tense 3:00 AM dread -> State B hand uncaps brass pen, makes one quick stroke on the notepad, snaps the cover shut, and shoulders drop

props.name: Warm amber low-wattage bedside toggle lamp and mechanical clock hands at 3:00
props.period_detail: analog clock hands pointing to three o'clock beside a hooded amber night-lamp
props.physical_behavior: State A deep blue-black 3:00 AM bedroom shadows -> State B soft amber click illuminates the closed notepad before clicking back to calm rest

actions.verb_sequence: bolts upright gripping the duvet in tense 3:00 AM worry -> uncaps the brass pen, parks one quick stroke onto the pocket notepad, snaps the cover shut, and lies back calmly

reactions.reaction: exhales slowly as shoulders release tension once the thought is parked until daylight

scenes.lighting: Deep indigo 3:00 AM moonlight balanced with a soft warm amber bedside rim.
scenes.recognition_hook: At 3:00 AM your forehead reality-checker is offline and your threat alarm runs 60 percent hotter—never negotiate with your midnight brain!

key_visual.description: a wide-awake adult sitting bolt upright in a moonlit bedroom at 3 AM who uncaps a brass pen to park a worry in a small leather notepad and snaps it shut

scenes.title: 8:00 AM Sunlit Backyard Patio: Same Note Looks Tiny in Morning Daylight
scenes.era: Modern 8:00 AM sunlit garden patio table

layout.description: Sun-drenched outdoor wooden patio table surrounded by morning garden greenery, steaming French-press coffee carafe, and the small pocket notepad from 3:00 AM.

positions.who: 50-year-old adult (now in crisp morning cardigan outdoors)
positions.where: seated at the sunlit outdoor patio table flipping open the small pocket notepad beside warm coffee

props.name: Glass French-press coffee carafe and flipped-open pocket notepad in sunlight
props.period_detail: warm morning sun glinting off freshly pressed coffee and small notebook
props.physical_behavior: hand flips open the 3:00 AM notepad, shrugs with a calm relieved smile, and presses the coffee plunger smoothly down

actions.verb_sequence: opens the pocket notepad in bright 8:00 AM garden sunlight -> shakes head with a relieved chuckle and pours morning coffee

reactions.reaction: calm, grounded perspective now that prefrontal braking is back online

scenes.wardrobe: Oatmeal knit morning cardigan over tee.
scenes.lighting: Bright warm 8:00 AM outdoor garden sunlight.
scenes.recognition_hook: The exact worry that felt like a ten-alarm crisis at 3:00 AM shrinks back to normal size once sunlight and deep sleep reconnect your prefrontal brake.

scenes.title: Brigham Circadian Crossover Suite: Biological Night vs Daytime Alignment
scenes.era: 2020 Harvard / Brigham inpatient circadian physiology suite

layout.description: Controlled time-free clinical suite where researchers track 24-hour circadian phase and fMRI prefrontal-amygdala coupling.

positions.where: comparing 3:00 AM circadian trough reactivity against 2:00 PM aligned calm

props.name: 24-hour brass circadian phase dial model
props.period_detail: physical day-night wheel marking the 2:00–4:00 AM trough
props.physical_behavior: researcher rotates the wheel into the midnight trough zone

actions.verb_sequence: rotates the 24-hour phase model to the 3:00 AM trough -> demonstrates mood drop across 4 misaligned days

reactions.reaction: recognizes biological clock timing as the hidden amplifier

scenes.recognition_hook: Being awake out of sync with your hypothalamic clock directly amplifies negative mood.
